newsitem.title: USA: US spot propane steady to slightly lower.
newsitem.headline: US spot propane steady to slightly lower.

text.p: U.S. spot propane prices were steady to lower in late trade on Thursday, little affected by the sharp sell off in NYMEX crude oil futures.
NYMEX December crude oil futures tumbled in late trade to end down 73 cents at $23.76 a barrel.
"It looks like we were hardly even impacted," said one Houston propane broker.
In the U.S. Gulf Coast, Mont Belvieu, Texas, spot propane shed 1.50 cents from strong intraday gains to between 60.25 cents and 60.50 cents a gallon.
The Midwest, however, held on to the five cents gained at midday, remaining 72.25/72.50 cents.

"There are a lot of dealers and (farm) cooperatives on the bottom side of half full and with this cold weather that has come through it has has caught a couple of them short," said a Conway, Kansas trader.

Meanwhile, players said they were awaiting the Energy Information Administration report due out later today. Much of the market was expecting a draw in stocks because of the cold weather and crop drying demand.
-- Laney Salisbury, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1631
